Line 10: `FileUtils.forceMkdir(tmp0);`

Since `file` was created using `name` which came from `zipEntry`, the value of `file` depends on `zipEntry`. There is no reassignment of `file` between line 4 and line 16. So yes, the value of `file` at line 16 depends on the value of `zipEntry` at line 1.
